purpose: Teach: 希少/翻弄/養殖/押し寄せ/異変/地質/学説/真偽

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、希少種の保護、論文、本当に、丁寧に、扱っていましたね、本気で、立派、絶対、印象的でした。
lines.en: Ren, the way you handled that paper on endangered species protection—really thoughtful, genuinely impressive work.
lines.style: Warm professional tone. Slow, deliberate. Pauses before key words like 'thoughtful' and 'impressive' to let them land. Genuine recognition without flattery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。気候変動に翻弄される、生物たちの姿、論文で、扱いました、本気で、深い、研究、できました、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. I focused on how climate change affects living creatures—how the research went deep into that specific challenge.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Measured pace. Light emphasis on 'deep' and 'specific challenge.' Speaks as if still in the thought-process of the work itself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 養殖技術の発展、本気で、人類の未来に、繋がるテーマですよね、論文で、扱っていました、桜さん、本気で、立派。
lines.en: Aquaculture development is such a crucial theme for humanity's future, and Sakura really engaged with it seriously in the paper.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost conversational. Slight lift on 'crucial' and 'humanity's future.' Voice stays warm but grows more reflective toward the end.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。観光客が、押し寄せた、観光地、本気で、環境負荷、深刻ですね、論文で、扱いました、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. Tourism flooding certain sites—the environmental damage is severe. That's what I focused on in the research.
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'severe' with a knowing tone. Speaks as though laying out a problem he understands deeply.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 気候の異変、本気で、地球規模で、進んでいますね、論文で、本気で、警鐘を、鳴らしていました、絶対、立派。
lines.en: Climate irregularities are accelerating globally—and the paper really sounds an important warning about that trend.
lines.style: Voice gains gentle urgency. Slightly quicker pace on 'accelerating globally.' Lands firmly on 'warning' as the core idea. Still warm, but more present.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。地質調査、本気で、貴重な、データ、得られました、論文で、扱いました、本当に、深い、研究、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Through geological surveys we obtained really valuable data. That data became the foundation of the whole research.
lines.style: Careful, methodical. Emphasizes 'valuable data' with quiet pride. Pace is steady, almost building through to 'foundation of the whole research.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 新しい学説、本気で、提示していますね、桜さん、本当に、独創的、絶対、評価できます、本気で、立派でした。
lines.en: You presented a genuinely novel framework there—Sakura, that took real originality and insight.
lines.style: Genuine admiration. Deliberate pace. Pauses before 'genuinely novel' and 'originality.' Voice carries the weight of real recognition, not routine praise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。情報の真偽、本気で、見極める姿勢、論文の核心でした、絶対、現代に、繋がる、テーマ、本気で、深い。
lines.en: Yes. The core of the paper was learning how to discern truth from false information—that skill is what connects this work to today's world.
lines.style: Thoughtful and grounded. Slow, deliberate pace throughout. Quiet emphasis on 'discern truth' and 'today's world.' Speaks with the gravity of understanding stakes.
